name: Firebase Studio
official_status_notes: Google announced sunset of Firebase Studio effective March 22, 2027; no new workspaces. Migration suggested to Google AI Studio / Google Antigravity (banner verified Sep 2026).
pricing_summary: Free during preview; Google Developer Program grants extra workspaces.
best_for: Rapid full-stack app prototyping in the browser while it remains available (until Mar 2027).
strengths: Full-stack agent (App Prototyping), Gemini AI, preview + Android emulator, deploy via App Hosting.
